US9589231B2.description: A patent document titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.description: The title of the patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting medical diagnosis.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space, supporting query-by-cases and query-by-experts.

Embedding Space.description: A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so their similarity can be computed.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space to find similar cases or experts.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case.

Experts.description: A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space, each embedded based on information such as profile, coded medical procedures, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

Requester.description: The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from available query types.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases.

Medical Ontology.description: A set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used to embed cases and experts.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A representation of a medical case computed based on a medical ontology, used for embedding in the embedding space.

Matrix Of Proximities.description: A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity.

Unified Medical Language System.description: A system on which the medical ontology is based.

Human Body Parts.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology, alongside biological functions, medical conditions, and pharmacological substances.

Biological Functions.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.

Medical Conditions.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.

Pharmacological Substances.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the ontology.

Expert Profile.description: Information associated with an expert used for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Coded Medical Procedures.description: Medical procedures performed by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Articles Authored By Expert.description: Articles written by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.entity_name: Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert
Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.description: Medical cases linked to an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Expert Availability.description: An attribute of an expert that may be used, along with rating and follower count, when returning a subset of experts.

Expert Rating.description: A rating of an expert that may be used when returning a subset of experts.

Expert Followers.description: The number of followers of an expert among users of the system, which may be used when returning a subset of experts.

Public Database.description: A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents when the query-for-cases is selected.

Diagnosis.description: The medical determination formulated by a selected expert for a new case provided to that expert.

Payment To Expert.description: A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.

Patient Records.description: A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, monitor results, diagnoses, and prescribed medications and treatments.

Laboratory Test Results.description: Records of laboratory tests that may form part of the new medical case.

Medical Images.description: Images that may form part of the new medical case.

Symptom Descriptions.description: Descriptions of symptoms that may form part of the new medical case.

Patient Monitor Results.description: Results of patient monitors that may form part of the new medical case.

Prescribed Medications And Treatments.description: Records of prescribed medications and treatments that may form part of the new medical case.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product.description: A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that when executed on a computer cause it to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Computer Processor.description: A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps.

records.description: The patent US9589231B2 bears the title "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance".

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.

Embedding Space.description: A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are represented as embeddings.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison.

Experts.description: A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom a new case may be communicated for diagnosis.

Query Types.description: A plurality of selectable query types including a query-for-cases and a query-for-experts.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Similarity Computation.description: The computation of similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases or embedded experts to determine returned subsets.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.

Processor.description: A processor in communication with memory that executes the stored instructions.

Memory.description: Memory that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, returning subsets, and computing costs.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries for cases and experts.

Network.description: A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.

User Devices.description: A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

Diagnosis.description: The diagnosis sought for a new case and attempted to be provided by an expert.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A representation generated in the embedding space for each existing case, each expert, and the new case.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method for diagnosis assistance that generates multidimensional representations, provides query types at differing costs, identifies subsets of cases or experts, and communicates the new case to an expert.
